newsitem.title: USA: Arco says no limits on Feb Line 63 shipments.
newsitem.headline: Arco says no limits on Feb Line 63 shipments.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co. said Tuesday it set no limits on February crude oil shipments on its California Line 63 pipeline.
"It will not be in pro-rationing for February," a company spokesman said, adding this is the third straight month the company has not set limits on shipments.
The line has been pro-rationed since a 1994 earthquake damaged a companion line, but in recent months, the spokesman said, shipper nominations have declined.
Line 63 runs from oil fields in California's San Joaquin Valley to Los Angeles.
